search_intent: Choose Chinese SUVs for Southeast Asian countries by steering side, national approval, ASEAN-market safety specification, monsoon use, charging and local service
buyer_task: Build a COUNTRY-specific Chinese-SUV shortlist by verifying the delivered national variant, ASEAN NCAP rating of that variant, monsoon/water suitability, charging and local service - explicitly NOT a regional ranking and NOT a seven-seat payload test or an FOB/CIF quote audit.

distinct_buyer_task.fob-cif-quote-check-southeast-asia: that page audits Incoterms/quote cost; this page covers variant admission, safety equipment, weather and charging.
distinct_buyer_task.battery-warranty-southeast-asia: that page verifies written battery-warranty entitlement; this page covers vehicle selection/safety/energy/service.
